correctness: All six workloads passed complete row-by-row verification in all 12 measurement processes; every measured run passed row-count checks.
method: 3 independent processes per engine/worker count, 2 warmups and 10 samples per workload. Summary is median of process medians; ranges describe process medians, not confidence intervals. Main/current process order alternates by replica.
input: 4,000,000 resident Int64 rows, 8192 rows/batch; value is NULL every 17th row, otherwise id%1000-500; group=id%256, selector=id%100; filter selector>50.
timing: Preparation includes physical plan construction, graph lowering and JIT; execution includes fresh state initialization, pipeline scheduling, output collection and task cleanup. Input generation, verification and output deallocation excluded.
threading: Tokio runtime worker count and pipeline parallelism set to 1 or 4 for both versions. Current also uses a Rayon pool capped at the same count via RAYON_NUM_THREADS; main uses its original scheduler. Counts refer to execution workers, not total OS threads.
scope: Whole-branch comparison, including scheduler and engine changes. No Parquet I/O, strings, joins, or exhaustive type coverage. Scan case passes resident batch handles to collection and is not a disk throughput test.
build: Separate source snapshots and separate release target directories. Shared dependency versions verified identical. Rustflags cleared. Executable, harness, source and lock hashes in metadata.json.
profiling: Separate untimed-results process, 30 samples per workload. macOS sample captured 3 seconds during grouped aggregation. These measurements are not included in summary. GroupIndex::intern_row key allocation/growth/free dominates its group_lookup path.
